name: Starving
text: After a day without enough food. You cannot heal or shed Stress. Roll STAMINA each day: failure costs 1 Health and +1 Stress. If Broken while Starving, make a Death Roll every day; MEDICAL AID cannot help, only food.

effects.text: Cannot recover Health or relieve Stress.
Daily STAMINA roll; failure = 1 damage.
Daily failed STAMINA roll = +1 Stress.

healBy: Eat something; the effects fade within one Shift.

name: Dehydrated
text: After a day without enough water. You cannot heal or shed Stress. Every Shift you take 1 damage and +1 Stress. If Broken while Dehydrated, make a Death Roll every Shift without fluids; MEDICAL AID cannot help.

effects.text: Cannot recover Health or relieve Stress.
1 damage every Shift.
+1 Stress every Shift.

healBy: Drink; the effects fade within one Shift.

name: Exhausted
text: After a day without at least a Shift of sleep. You cannot relieve Stress. Once per day (GM's timing) roll STAMINA with a penalty equal to the days without proper sleep; failure means you collapse and sleep for a Shift.

effects.text: Cannot relieve Stress.
Daily STAMINA roll at -1 per sleepless day; failure = collapse asleep for a Shift.

healBy: Sleep for at least one Shift.

name: Freezing
text: Without enough clothing or shelter in the cold. You cannot heal or shed Stress. Roll STAMINA at intervals: daily above freezing, every Shift below zero, every Turn in deep space cold. Failure: 1 damage and +1 Stress. If Broken while Freezing, make a Death Roll at the next cold check.

effects.text: Cannot recover Health or relieve Stress.
Failed cold STAMINA roll = 1 damage.
Failed cold STAMINA roll = +1 Stress.

healBy: Get warm; rolling stops and recovery works normally again.

name: Sick (Disease)
text: Failed a Sickness Roll (opposed STAMINA vs the disease's Virulence, typically 3). One Shift after infection you take 1 damage; you cannot heal while sick; at the start of each Shift roll again, each failure = 1 more damage. If Broken while sick, a failed Sickness Roll each Shift is fatal. A carer may roll MEDICAL AID vs Virulence instead.

effects.text: Cannot recover Health.
1 damage per failed Sickness Roll (each Shift).

healBy: Succeed at one Sickness Roll (STAMINA or a carer's MEDICAL AID vs Virulence).

name: Irradiated
text: Each time you gain a Rad, roll dice equal to your total Rads; each success is 1 damage. Weak radiation gives 1 Rad per Shift, strong 1 per Turn, extreme 1 per Round. Broken by radiation: Death Roll at every new Rad. No healing while in the hotspot.

effects.text: Roll dice equal to current Rads at each new Rad; 1 damage per success.

healBy: Leave the area; heal 1 Rad per Shift. Each time a Rad would heal, roll a Stress Die: a facehugger result makes that Rad permanent.

name: Broken
text: At zero Health. Roll a critical injury immediately. You can only crawl and mumble: no other actions or skill rolls. Each further damaging attack inflicts another critical injury.

effects.text: No actions or skill rolls except crawling.
Each further damaging hit = another critical injury.

healBy: First aid (MEDICAL AID, slow action) restores Health equal to successes, or on your own you regain 1 Health after a Turn.

name: On Fire
text: If fire damages you, you keep burning: another attack at the start of each Round with Intensity +1 each time, until an attack deals no damage. Broken by fire: Death Roll every Round until dead or saved by MEDICAL AID.

effects.text: Fire attack each Round, Intensity rising by 1.

healBy: A MOBILITY roll (slow action) by you or someone ENGAGED puts it out; or it dies when a fire attack deals no damage.

name: Acid Burn
text: Hit by a Xenomorph's acid splash. At the start of each Round you suffer another acid attack with half the previous dice (round down) until a roll deals no damage. Each success also strips 1 from the armor's rating. Broken by acid: Death Roll every Round until dead or saved by MEDICAL AID.

effects.text: Repeat acid attack each Round at half dice.
Each success on acid dice reduces worn Armor Rating by 1.

healBy: Burns out when an acid roll deals no damage.

name: Suffocating
text: Out of air: roll STAMINA every Turn and after strenuous action, the first roll unmodified, then -1, -2 and so on. Failure drops you to 0 Health with a Death Roll every Round (no critical injury).

effects.text: Cumulative -1 per STAMINA roll.

healBy: Reach a pressurized area or a fresh air supply.

name: Exposed to Vacuum
text: Unprotected in space: roll STAMINA every Round before acting (not an action), unmodified the first Round then -1, -2 and so on. Failure drops you to 0 Health with a Death Roll every Round (no critical injury). Pulling on a suit fast is a slow action needing MOBILITY.

effects.text: Cumulative -1 per Round.

healBy: Get into a pressurized area or a suit.

name: Drowning
text: Underwater: roll STAMINA every Round before acting (not an action); failure = 1 damage. Broken while drowning: Death Roll every Turn until dead or saved by MEDICAL AID.

effects.text: Failed STAMINA = 1 damage per Round.

healBy: Surface or be pulled out.

name: Stunned
text: Electroshock, stun weapons and some creature attacks: you lose your actions for one Round.

effects.text: Lose actions for one Round.

healBy: Wears off after one Round.

name: Over-Encumbered
text: Carrying more than STRENGTH x2 items (up to STRENGTH x4). To run or crawl in combat you must pass MOBILITY or drop the load / stay put.

effects.text: MOBILITY roll required to run or crawl in combat.

healBy: Drop items until at or below STRENGTH x2.

name: Paralyzed (Xenomorph Venom)
text: Stung by a Capture for the Hive attack: roll STAMINA; you stay up one Round per success, then fall unconscious for a Shift.

effects.text: Unconscious for one Shift after (STAMINA successes) Rounds.

healBy: A shot of adrenaline: MEDICAL AID roll using a medkit.

name: Facehugged / Implanted
text: Unconscious with a facehugger attached. Within a Shift it drops off dead and you wake hungry; one Shift later a chestburster is born and kills you. Removing a hugger by force usually kills the host.

effects.text: Unconscious; chestburster birth (death) two Shifts after the attack.

healBy: No standard cure; hypersleep/stasis halts the gestation (GM discretion).

name: Nerve Agent Exposure
text: In a CN-20 zone without a hazmat suit: STAMINA at -3 each Round before acting; failure = 1 damage and +1 Stress, repeating every Round even after leaving the zone. Broken: Death Roll every Round.

effects.text: 1 damage per Round.
+1 Stress per Round.

healBy: Only a hard (-2) MEDICAL AID roll saves a Broken victim.

name: Anathema Infection (Black Goo)
text: Failed a Sickness Roll vs Virulence 8 after exposure to the black goo. You become a Stage I Vitiate within a Shift, then must keep rolling vs Virulence 8 each Shift; failure advances to Stage II, then Stage III or IV. Success only delays it. Stage III+ PCs become NPCs.

effects.text: Stage I/II symptoms each add +1 Stress.

healBy: No known cure.

name: Phobia
text: You fear something tied to the panic's cause (GM picks). +1 Stress when within SHORT range of it; staying near it longer than a Round forces a Panic Roll.

effects.text: +1 Stress within SHORT range of the phobia.

healBy: Permanent.

name: Alcoholism
text: You must drink every Shift or gain +1 Stress, and you cannot relieve stress without alcohol.

effects.text: +1 Stress per Shift without a drink.

healBy: Permanent.

name: Nightmares
text: Roll EMPATHY when you sleep; on a success you have a nightmare: +1 Stress and no stress relief for a full day.

effects.text: +1 Stress on a nightmare.

healBy: Permanent.

name: Depression
text: Roll EMPATHY every day; failure means a bad day: +1 Stress and no stress relief until the next day.

effects.text: +1 Stress on a bad day.

healBy: Permanent.

name: Drug Use
text: You need a recreational drug every Shift or gain +1 Stress, and cannot relieve stress without it.

effects.text: +1 Stress per Shift without the drug.

healBy: Permanent.

name: Amnesia
text: You no longer remember who you or the other characters are; roleplay it.

effects.text: Memory wiped (roleplay).

healBy: Permanent.
